# PageContext

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The page facts a conditional pagination primitive decides on.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Implements `IEquatable<PageContext>`.

### `IsLastPage`

```csharp
bool IsLastPage { get; set; }
```

True on the document's last page. Only meaningful during the second layout pass; on the first pass the total page count is not yet known and this reports the engine's running view.

### `PageNumber`


1-based number of the page the element is being rendered on.
